hub.description: A unified web portal and interactive suite for homebrew applications, reverse-engineering save editors, and console display plugins.

apps.name: Skyward Sword HD Save Editor
apps.tagline: Web-based binary editor for wiiking2.sav with client-side CRC32 integrity engine.
apps.description: Edit rupees, heart containers, player name, pouch equipment, and inventory ammo directly in your browser. Features real-time Little-Endian parsing and automatic Big-Endian CRC32 recalculation on save export.
features: Interactive heart container & quarter-heart health tuning
Rupees up to 9,999 with Tycoon Wallet support
Slot switcher: Save File 1, 2, 3, and Autosave
Client-side IEEE 802.3 CRC32 recalculation
Raw byte hex inspector for live offset verification
Zero setup: 100% private in-browser editing

apps.name: Xenoblade Chronicles Save Tool
apps.tagline: Convert Wii monado saves into Switch Definitive Edition saves with pre-clear spoiler protection.
apps.description: Translates characters (Shulk, Reyn, Dunban, Sharla, Riki, Melia, Seven), EXP, AP, money, and play time from Wii (SX4E) saves into native Switch XC:DE format. Pairs each save with verified .tmb thumbnails and retains clean title screen states.
features: In-browser binary converter for monado01-03
Pre-clear template preservation (no title screen spoilers)
Party stat inspector: character levels, EXP, and AP
Header play time recalculator matching Wii timestamps
1-click download of ready-to-restore JKSV saves
Interactive save visualizer and inspector

apps.name: Kickass Homebrew
apps.tagline: Retro synthwave LÖVE Potion homebrew suite engineered for Switch Applet Mode (~5.3MB).
apps.description: A high-performance Nintendo Switch homebrew featuring an 80s synthwave perspective grid, telemetry-driven arcade HUD, photosensitivity strobe tuner, Picross 5x5 step solver, and 9x9 Sudoku MRV constraint solver.
features: Ultra-lightweight memory profile (~5.3MB) safe for Album mode
Real-time D-Pad and joystick controller telemetry HUD
Interactive 5x5 Picross logic deduction visualizer
9x9 Sudoku solver using Minimum Remaining Values (MRV)
Synthwave perspective grid and wave WordArt rendering
Pre-packaged standalone executable ready for sdmc:/switch/

apps.name: Sharpscale Multi-Console Suite
apps.tagline: Eliminate hardware bilinear blur with integer scaling and nearest-neighbor overrides.
apps.description: Hardware display plugins and configuration utilities for Nintendo Switch (Sharpscale-NX via SaltyNX & Tesla) and Nintendo 3DS (Sharpscale-3DS via Luma 3GX & FIRM patcher) delivering razor-sharp, pixel-perfect visuals.
features: Auto-calculated integer scaling for 1080p and 720p displays
Hardware swapchain sampler override for point/nearest-neighbor filtering
AMD Contrast Adaptive Sharpening (CAS) shader pass
3DS 800x240 Progressive 2D mode with custom bezels
Tesla Overlay (Switch) and Luma 3GX in-game configuration menus
Automated devkitPro CI/CD build actions
